subject: Conditional PO waiver, evidence & SLA tradeoffs for Nimblabs pilot
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Grant <sophie@nimblabs.io>, Nimblabs Procurement <procurement@nimblabs.io>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 18 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Conditional PO waiver, evidence & SLA tradeoffs for Nimblabs pilot

Hi Sophie / Nimblabs procurement team,

Thanks for the interest in running the two-week pilot with Redwood. Before we lock dates, procurement asked whether a formal PO is required for this pilot engagement. To move quickly we can accommodate a temporary "invoice-only" path for the pilot under the following conditions:

- Pilot will be billed monthly in arrears, capped at $7,500.
- Nimblabs signs the attached SOW (pilot-sow-v1.pdf) and the existing NDA (we have a signed copy attached).
- Redwood will provide SOC 2 Type II evidence on a limited-scope basis (redacted) within the pilot week.
- SLA credits for production-grade SLAs are not available for pilot; instead we can offer a 5% credit on any invoice for extended downtime incidents during the pilot window.

If procurement insists on a PO we can still accept one — it won't block scheduling — but approval will require a short procurement intake and finance ticket which typically adds ~5 business days.

Next steps I propose:
1) Sophie, confirm you can accept the invoice-only path with the items above.
2) If yes, we sign the SOW and I will send a DocuSign amendment for the pilot waiver.
3) Internal ops: Karthik / Priyom, please prepare the temporary vendor allowlist and evidence packet.

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Lead | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0123

Attachments: pilot-sow-v1.pdf, NDA_signed.pdf

Hi Marissa,

Thanks — we want to move quickly and the invoice-only route sounds workable for the pilot. A few clarifications from procurement:
- We will need a redacted SOC 2 excerpt or letter that confirms control coverage for hosting and encryption before the pilot start.
- Can the invoice be issued to Nimblabs Inc (1099) and emailed to procurement@nimblabs.io?
- Pilot scope and deliverables need to be explicit in the SOW (duration, expected token volumes, success criteria).

I'll review the SOW now and circle back with a PO request only if finance insists.

— Sophie

Marissa —

Thanks for the summary. A couple of internal notes from procurement's side:
- We can approve a temporary invoice-only onboarding for pilots under $10k where there is a signed SOW and basic security evidence. That fits this case, but we need a documented approval (PO-waiver-criteria.docx) signed by Legal / Procurement.
- Please flag whether Nimblabs requests any data retention beyond standard default (we need to lock retention policy in the SOW to avoid an exception).
- For compliance: if SOC 2 excerpts are redacted, Legal needs to confirm they are sufficient.

Lauren — can you take a quick look at the redacted evidence when Marissa uploads it and confirm the waiver can be granted? If possible, provide the sign-off text we can attach to the vendor record.

Karthik

Perfect — appreciate the quick turn. I've attached an updated SOW that calls out token volume bands and the pilot success criteria. Highlights / concessions from Redwood:

- Security evidence: we'll provide a redacted SOC 2 report excerpt and a SOC attestation letter via a secure link by EOD Monday.
- Billing: invoice to "Nimblabs Inc" emailed to procurement@nimblabs.io; terms net 30.
- Data retention: default 30 days for the pilot; request to keep logs longer will require a separate data-processing agreement.
- SLA tradeoff: because pilot traffic will be on shared infra we can't provide production SLA credits beyond the 5% invoice credit for severe incidents; we can revisit SLA for production onboarding.

If that aligns, I'll drop a DocuSign amendment (link below) and we can start the pilot kickoff on Mon 5/22.

Karthik / Marissa —

I've reviewed the proposed redacted SOC excerpt and the pilot SOW. Legal is comfortable approving a temporary PO waiver for this specific pilot under these narrow conditions:

1) Pilot capped at $10,000 and signed SOW on file.
2) Default data retention of 30 days; any retention requests beyond this need a separate DPA.
3) Redacted SOC 2 excerpt and attestation letter must be uploaded to the vendor record (we will mark the evidence as "limited scope: pilot only").
4) Procurement signs the PO-waiver-criteria.docx and attaches it to the vendor file.

Please route the waiver approval back through Procurement (Karthik) after Marissa confirms the uploads. I'll provide the exact sign-off snippet you can paste into the vendor record: "Legal approves temporary PO-waiver for Nimblabs pilot (scope and evidence as stated), valid until 2028-06-05 or until production onboarding request is submitted."

Lauren Bishop
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference
